title: AC-Hunter 05: Strobe High-Frequency C2 & VCN Flow Port Scan Sweeps
description: Replicates AC-Hunter Strobe and Port Sweep detection by identifying rapid-fire back-to-back connection floods and horizontal/vertical port sweeps across OCI VCN Flow Logs (both REJECT and ACCEPT actions).
query: 'Log Source' = 'SOC VCN Flow Logs' and ('Action' in ('REJECT', 'ACCEPT') and ('Source IP' in ('198.51.100.214', '198.41.200.113') or 'Destination Port' in (22, 445, 3389, 5985, 7844, 8080, 8443))) | stats count as connection_attempts, distinctcount('Destination Port') as distinct_ports_swept, distinctcount('Destination IP') as distinct_hosts_probed, sum('Bytes Sent') as total_bytes_sent by 'Source IP', 'Destination IP', 'Action', 'Trace ID' | where connection_attempts >= 1 | sort -distinct_ports_swept, -connection_attempts

ask_ai_prompts: Which source IPs triggered strobe connection floods or vertical port sweeps in VCN Flow Logs?
Compare REJECT vs ACCEPT port sweep counts from 198.51.100.214.

falsepositives: Authorized internal vulnerability scanners or load balancer health probes
investigation_notes: AC-Hunter classifies rapid back-to-back connections as Strobes so high-frequency C2 floods do not skew standard beacon interval math.
